reader.label: Effective little-o bound in the treewidth

sourceBasis.step: Theorem 6 gives W[1]-hardness through XNLP-hardness for pathwidth divided by the logarithm of the graph order. For a Clique instance of length M and parameter k, the reduction therefore produces a graph of pathwidth at most g(k)(1+log₂ M) for a computable g. Treewidth satisfies the same upper bound. Using the effective cutoff with accuracy 1/g(k) bounds the exponential factor by a computable function of k times M. The resulting Clique algorithm would be fixed-parameter tractable.

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Odd Cycle Transversal within the stated running time.
